It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} ({{ill|Myōjin Taisha|fr|Myōjin Taisha|ja|名神大社|simple|Myōjin Taisha|zh|名神大社|qid=Q9610964}}), its former rank under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines}} was {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=kokuhei chūsha}}, and it is now a {{ill|Beppyo shrine|ja|別表神社|mr|बेप्प्यो तीर्थ|simple|Beppyo shrine|zh|別表神社|qid=Q10898274}} of the {{ill|Association of Shinto Shrines|ca|Associació de Santuaris Xinto|fr|Association des sanctuaires shinto|id|Asosiasi Kuil Shinto|it|Associazione dei santuari shintoisti|ja|神社本庁|ko|신사본청|ru|Дзиндзя хонтё|simple|Association of Shinto Shrines|sv|Jinja Honcho|zh|神社本廳|qid=Q908077}}. {{nihongo|'''Sumiyoshi Shrine'''|住吉神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932|lt=Engishiki Jinmyōchō}}. It is located in {{ill|Iki Island|arz|ايكى|az|İki adası|be|Ікі|ceb|Ikino Shima|ckb|دوورگەی ئیکی|cs|Iki (ostrov)|de|Iki (Insel)|es|Isla Iki|et|Iki saar|eu|Iki uhartea|fa|ایکی‌نوشیما|fr|Île Iki|ja|壱岐島|ko|이키섬|lt|Ikis (sala)|pl|Iki (wyspa)|pt|Ilha Iki|ro|Insula Iki|ru|Ики (остров)|sv|Ikiöarna|tr|Iki Adası|uk|Ікі (острів)|zh|壹岐島|zh_yue|壹岐島|qid=Q494914|lt=Iki Island}}.

== Enshrined deities ==
Sokotsutsu-no-o-no-Mikoto, Nakatsutsu-no-o-no-Mikoto, and Uwatsutsu-no-o-no-Mikoto are the main deities, collectively called the "{{ill|Sumiyoshi sanjin|de|Sumiyoshi Sanjin|it|Sumiyoshi Sanjin|ja|住吉三神|mni|ꯁꯨꯃꯤꯌꯣꯁꯤ ꯁꯟꯖꯤꯟ|my|ဆုမိရောရှိနတ်သုံးပါး|pl|Sumiyoshi Sanjin|simple|Sumiyoshi sanjin|zh|住吉三神|qid=Q1114013|lt=Sumiyoshi Ōkami}}." {{ill|Ōkuninushi|ca|Ōkuninushi|es|Ōkuninushi|fa|اوکونینوشی|fr|Ōkuninushi|hu|Ókuninusi|id|Ookuninushi|it|Ōkuninushi|ja|大国主|ko|오오쿠니누시|mni|ꯑꯣꯀꯨꯅꯤꯅꯨꯁꯤ|pl|Ōkuninushi|pt|Ookuninushi|ru|Окунинуси|simple|Ōkuninushi|sr|Okuninuši|sv|Ōkuninushi|tr|Ōkuninushi|uk|Окунінуші|vi|Ōkuninushi|zh|大國主|qid=Q276944|lt=Yachihoko-no-Kami}} is enshrined in the associated hall.

== History ==
According to shrine tradition, {{ill|Empress Jingū|ar|الإمبراطورة جينغو|arz|الامبراطوره جينجو|az|Cinqu|bcl|Empress Jingū|ca|Jingu|cs|Džingú|de|Jingū|es|Jingū|eu|Jingū enperatriza|fa|امپراتریس جینگو|fr|Jingū|hr|Jingū (japanska carica)|hu|Dzsingú japán császárnő|id|Permaisuri Jingū|it|Jingū|ja|神功皇后|ka|ძინგუ|ko|진구 황후|nl|Jingu|pl|Jingū|pt|Jingu|ru|Императрица Дзингу|sh|Carica Jingū|si|ජින්ගූ අධිරාජිනිය|simple|Empress Jingū|sl|Cesarica Džingu|sv|Jingu Kogo|te|రాణి జింగూ|th|จักรพรรดินีจิงงู|tl|Emperatris Jingū|tr|Jingū (imparatoriçe)|uk|Імператриця Дзінґу|uz|Imperator Jingū|vi|Thiên hoàng Jingū|zh|神功皇后|zh_min_nan|Sîn-kong Hông-hō͘|zh_yue|神功皇后|qid=Q232803}}, who accomplished {{ill|Three Han Campaign|ja|三韓征伐|ko|삼한 정벌|zh|三韩征伐|qid=Q11249435}} under the protection of the Sumiyoshi deities, landed on her return at present Ōura-fure, Gōnoura-chō, Iki City and enshrined the three deities there (hence the claim of being "Japan's first Sumiyoshi Shrine"). It later moved to the current location by {{ill|Oracle|af|Orakel|ar|وسيط الوحي|az|Orakul|be|Аракул|be_x_old|Аракул|bg|Оракул|ca|Oracle|cs|Věštec|da|Orakel|de|Orakel|el|Μαντείο|eo|Orakolo|es|Oráculo|eu|Orakulu|fa|وخشور|fi|Oraakkeli|fy|Orakel|he|אורקל|hi|दैवज्ञ|hu|Orákulum|id|Orakel|io|Oraklo|it|Oracolo|ja|神託|ka|ორაკული|kk|Оракул|kn|ಆರಕಲ್|ko|신탁 (종교)|ky|Олуя|la|Oraculum|lt|Orakulas|ml|കോമരം (വെളിച്ചപ്പാട്)|ms|Takahun|myv|Чартлиця|nl|Orakel|no|Orakel|pl|Wyrocznia|pt|Oráculo|ro|Oracol|ru|Оракул|sh|Proročište|simple|Oracle|sl|Preročišče|sq|Orakulli|sr|Пророчиште|sv|Orakel|ta|ஆரக்கிள்|tl|Orakulo|tr|Orakl|uk|Оракул|war|Orakulo|yi|אראקל|zh|神諭|qid=Q217123}}. In the '{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932}}' it was ranked as myōjin taisha. It also claims to be the leading shrine in Nagasaki Prefecture.

== Annual festival ==
* Grand annual festival - November 9

== Cultural properties ==
== Nagasaki Prefecture designated cultural property ==
* Tangible cultural property
** Silk painting of the Four Kōya Shrine Deities (painting) - made after the middle Muromachi period. Donated in Meiji 27 (1894) by a donor from Ashibe-chō living in Osaka. Designated March 4, Shōwa 50 (1975)<ref name="説明板"/><ref>'Cultural Properties of Iki City,' Iki City Board of Education, Nagasaki, 2017, p.20.</ref>.

== Iki City designated cultural properties ==
* Tangible cultural properties
** 17 sacred mirrors of Sumiyoshi Shrine (crafts) - mirrors found in 1871 in the sacred pond within Sumiyoshi Shrine precincts. Breakdown: 12 continental-style mirrors, 5 Japanese-style mirrors. Designated January 1, Shōwa 51 (1976)<ref name="説明板">Precinct information board.</ref><ref>'Cultural Properties of Iki City,' Iki City Board of Education, Nagasaki, 2017, p.90.</ref>.
** Miyuki-bune (craft) - boat used in the boat ritual of the Sumiyoshi Shrine annual festival. Newly built in Shōwa 8 (1933)<ref>'Cultural Properties of Iki City,' Iki City Board of Education, Nagasaki, 2017, p.98.</ref>.
* Natural monument
** [[ファイル:Iki sumiyoshi shrine sando.jpg|サムネイル|Haiden viewed from approach]][[ファイル:Iki sumiyoshishrine kusu.jpg|サムネイル|"Married camphor trees" in front of haiden]]Two camphor trees of Sumiyoshi Shrine - designated January 1, Shōwa 51 (1976)<ref name="説明板"/><ref>'Cultural Properties of Iki City,' Iki City Board of Education, Nagasaki, 2017, p.196.</ref>.
